_readme: Operator-verified limits for this demo plant. Each 'source' cites where the number came from. AEGIS never invents these; it applies a check only when a limit is present here or stated in the query/retrieved SOP.

pressure.source: SOP-MNT-402 Rev.3 Section 2 (safe <15 bar(g), CRITICAL >=18 bar(g))

temperature.source: SOP-CDU-014 Section 1 (COT normal 340-360 degC, high alarm 370 degC)

vibration.source: ISO 10816-3 Group 2 rigid-mount Zone C/D boundary (7.1 mm/s RMS); mirrored in SOP-ROT-118 Section 3

wall_thickness.source: Vessel datasheet minimum allowable wall thickness 6.35 mm (0.25 in), per SOP-MNT-402 inspection appendix
